description:
List participants behind a churn category

The drill-down: the participant IDs behind one churn category count for this Provider over the period, newest observation day first. `counterpart` narrows a mover category to the participants won from or lost to one Provider. Cursor-paginated in pages of at most 500: follow `next_cursor` until it is null.

counterpart.description: Filter to one counterpart Provider key: the Provider the participants were won from (`mover_in`) or lost to (`mover_out`). Not allowed with `joiner` or `leaver`. An unknown key returns an empty list.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor returned as `next_cursor` by the previous page.

limit.description: Page size, clamped to [1, 500]. Defaults to 500 (20 through MCP).

name: list_access_point_churn_participants
